examples.arabic: لأ، انا مشغول بكرة عشان هاعمل رياضة.
examples.english: No, I am busy tomorrow because I will do sports.
examples.transliteration: La, ana mashghool bokra ashan haamel reyada.

examples.arabic: هو رد قال الحمد لله كويس بس كنت مشغول شوية
examples.english: He replied, "Praise be to God, good, but I was a little busy."
examples.transliteration: howwa radd al el-hamdulillah kwayyes bas kont mashghool shwayya

examples.english: Dad is busy at work now.
examples.storyTitle: The Light Bulb Problem at Home

examples.arabic: هو قال انا كويس بس انا مشغول في الشغل
examples.english: He said "I am fine, but I am busy with work."
examples.transliteration: Howa 'al: Ana kwayyis bas ana mashghool fel-shoghl.

examples.arabic: عندي شغل كتير والصباح ده مشغول
examples.english: I have a lot of work and this morning is busy.
examples.transliteration: 'Andy shoghl kiteer wal sabah da mashghoul.
